resources.string: A personal SMS management application designed to provide a convenient inbox, search, organization, and user-controlled backup experience.
Allows AFX SMS Manager to display your device SMS inbox and sent messages locally, enable search and favorites, and create backups that you explicitly initiate.
Allows the app to detect newly arriving SMS messages to refresh your local inbox and show an optional local notification.
Optional permission used solely to display saved contact names alongside phone numbers in your local inbox.
Used for backup completion/failure alerts, optional new SMS notifications, and user-enabled backup reminders.
Optional local notifications when a new SMS arrives
Notifications for local and Telegram backup completion or errors
Scheduled reminders to create a local backup of your messages
